mapper.sql: id, member_id, item_id, sku_id, quantity, checked, pet_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND checked = 1 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM pet_cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM pet_cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_cart_item WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_cart_item (member_id, item_id, sku_id, quantity, checked, pet_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{itemId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{checked}, #{petId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
